bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for People in Action.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; PEOPLE IN ACTION.

$700,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $700,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to the nonprofit organization People in Action for statewide Somali-based collaborative programs for arts and cultural heritage. The funding must be used for arts education, workshops, mentor programs, community presentations, and engagement events throughout Minnesota.
additions: $700,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $700,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to the nonprofit organization People in Action for statewide Somali-based collaborative programs for arts and cultural heritage. The funding must be used for arts education, workshops, mentor programs, community presentations, and engagement events throughout Minnesota.
